title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming parity across python/ts/go; bump v1.186.1
author: Ethan Park
release_notes: Bump SDKs to v1.186.1: unifies auth token refresh and retry behavior across Python/TS/Go, restores parity for streaming API ergonomics, and includes small ergonomics/typing fixes. No breaking API changes.
body:
Summary: This PR unifies authentication/refresh logic, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, and publishes version bumps to v1.186.1. Motivation: multiple customers and internal teams hit inconsistent retry behavior between SDKs (ENG-4821) and reported edge cases for streaming reconnects and auth refresh races (SUP-1045). The goal is parity: same high-level semantics, consistent default timeouts, and clearer ergonomics for streaming consumers.

What this changes (high level):
- Centralize auth token refresh behavior so SDKs will proactively refresh tokens on 401/403 windows and avoid duplicate refreshes in concurrent requests.
- Standardize retry policy: idempotency map + exponential backoff with jitter, default max_retries=4 for idempotent endpoints and 1 for non-idempotent generation calls, and a configurable global RetryConfig.
- Streaming API ergonomics: unify server-side reconnect semantics, expose a consistent "on_retry" callback for streaming consumers, and provide explicit abort/cleanup helpers for Python/TS/Go.
- Type/typing and docs updates for Python/TS to make the new ergonomics discoverable.
- Version bumps across packages: python-sdk v1.186.1, typescript-sdk v1.186.1, go-sdk v1.186.1.

Checklist: [x] Design doc linked (ENG-4821) [x] Unit + integration tests updated [x] End-to-end streaming smoke tests [x] Changelog entries for all SDKs [x] Internal migration guide added (devs)

Commits summary: ["c1a9f2a: python: centralize auth refresh + add mutex to prevent duplicate refresh", "b7e4d01: typescript: align retry config and backoff with python defaults", "fa3d8c9: go: add streaming on_retry hook + abort helper", "e4b2c11: sdk-common: extract RetryConfig and IdempotencyMap", "d2a3f44: docs: SDK ergonomics and migration guide", "9c1b7d0: bump versions to v1.186.1 and update changelogs"]

Files changed (high level): ["sdks/python/redwood/auth.py - add TokenRefresher, consolidate request flow", "sdks/python/redwood/retries.py - new RetryConfig and backoff util", "sdks/python/redwood/streaming.py - add on_retry callback and abort helper", "sdks/typescript/src/auth.ts - mirror TokenRefresher behavior", "sdks/typescript/src/retries.ts - align backoff and defaults", "sdks/go/auth.go - token refresh flow + mutex", "sdks/go/streaming.go - expose OnRetry and AbortStream", "sdk-common/retry_config.go - shared config + docs", "docs/sdks/migration_v1.186.1.md - migration guide and examples"]

Tests and CI: Initial CI run had a flaky streaming integration on the TS matrix (failed with transient network handshake timeouts). I reran the job after extending test timeouts and adding an additional jitter in the TS reconnect logic; subsequent CI came back green. CI checks run: unit (python/ts/go) ✅, linters (flake8/eslint/gofmt) ✅, integration streaming smoke tests ✅, package publish dry-run ✅.

Review conversation (high level):
- Maya Chen: "Great cleanup. Left comments around race conditions during concurrent refreshes in Python; prefer using an async lock to avoid blocking callers."
- Ethan Park (author): "Addressed — moved to an AsyncTokenRefresher and added unit tests that simulate concurrent requests. See commit c1a9f2a."
- Carlos Rivera: "Typescript retry defaults look good; please add explicit docs showing how to opt into stricter retry for idempotent workloads."
- Ethan Park: "Added docs and examples in docs/sdks/retries.md and included a small snippet in the migration guide."
- Priya Singh: "Can you confirm no behavioral regressions for current customers on Dedicated?"
- Ethan Park: "Ran the Dedicated smoke-runbook; no regressions observed. Also added a short note in the release notes pointing to self-hosted configuration knobs."

Manual testing notes:
- Simulated token expiry during high-concurrency python worker (200 concurrent requests) — token refresh serialized, no duplicate refresh calls observed.
- Streaming reconnect simulated by blocking socket for 2s — on_retry fired consistently in all SDKs; abort helper closed resources and freed goroutines/async tasks.

Migration notes for integrators:
- If you override retry settings directly, migrate to the new RetryConfig shape (see docs). Default behavior remains backward-compatible for most users, but customers with custom retry wrappers should verify interactions with the SDK-level idempotency map.
- Streaming consumers relying on internal reconnect internals should switch to using the public on_retry callback and AbortStream helper.

Merge: squash and merge to main. Release process: packages staged and pushed to our internal registry; tags created for each SDK (v1.186.1).

Follow-ups (tracked): ENG-4999 - telemetry to capture token refresh counts per tenant; ENG-5033 - add more streaming stress tests to perf-canary.
